mapper.select: SELECT ut.id as testCaseId, ut.task_id as taskId, ut.task_name as taskName, ut.test_case_name as testCaseName, ut.test_target as testTarget, ut.test_type as testType, ut.priority, ut.description, ut.precondition, ut.test_data as testData, ut.test_steps as testSteps, ut.expected_result as expectedResult, ut.actual_result as actualResult, ut.test_status as testStatus, ut.execution_date as executionDate, ut.duration, ut.notes, ut.requirements, ut.assignee, COALESCE(u.name, ut.assignee) as assigneeName, ut.is_deleted as isDeleted, ut.created_at as createdAt, ut.updated_at as updatedAt, ut.created_by as createdBy, ut.updated_by as updatedBy, ut.pjt_id as pjtId FROM unit_test_case ut LEFT JOIN users u ON ut.assignee = u.user_id WHERE ut.id = #{testCaseId} AND ut.is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO unit_test_case ( id, task_id, task_name, test_case_name, test_target, test_type, priority, description, precondition, test_data, test_steps, expected_result, actual_result, test_status, execution_date, duration, notes, requirements, assignee, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, pjt_id ) VALUES ( #{testCaseId}, #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{testCaseName}, #{testTarget}, #{testType}, #{priority}, #{description}, #{precondition}, #{testData}, #{testSteps}, #{expectedResult}, #{actualResult}, #{testStatus}, #{executionDate}, #{duration}, #{notes}, #{requirements}, #{assignee}, 'N', NOW(), NOW(), #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{pjtId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE unit_test_case SET task_id = #{taskId}, task_name = #{taskName}, test_case_name = #{testCaseName}, test_target = #{testTarget}, test_type = #{testType}, priority = #{priority}, description = #{description}, precondition = #{precondition}, test_data = #{testData}, test_steps = #{testSteps}, expected_result = #{expectedResult}, actual_result = #{actualResult}, test_status = #{testStatus}, execution_date = #{executionDate}, duration = #{duration}, notes = #{notes}, requirements = #{requirements}, assignee = #{assignee}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, pjt_id = #{pjtId} WHERE id = #{testCaseId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE unit_test_case SET test_status = #{testStatus}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{testCaseId} AND is_deleted = 'N'

UPDATE unit_test_case SET actual_result = #{actualResult}, test_status = #{testStatus}, duration = #{duration}, notes = #{notes}, execution_date = #{executionDate}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{testCaseId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.select:
SELECT id as testCaseId, test_case_name as testCaseName, test_status as testStatus, execution_date as executionDate, duration, assignee FROM unit_test_case WHERE is_deleted = 'N' AND execution_date IS NOT NULL
AND pjt_id = #{pjtId}
ORDER BY execution_date DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(id, 4) AS UNSIGNED)) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(id, 4) AS UNSIGNED)) + 1 END as nextSequence FROM unit_test_case WHERE id REGEXP '^TC_[0-9]{3}$' AND is_deleted = 'N'
